251 -> 247 (-4), and the undeclared-reach subtotal 4 -> 0: the addon now has no cross-module read of a private that no contract publishes.

Four sites, three decisions:
  - record_validator.js read list._currentIds; StaticList already publishes currentIds over it. Narrowed to the getter. The two hand-rolled list doubles in the validator suites modelled the internal name and had to grow the published one, which is the point: a double shaped like the working memory keeps the debt alive by making the contract the thing that breaks.
  - dynamic_list.js read list._commands twice to build the many2many half of a save's change report, re-deriving LINK/UNLINK from the raw tuples. Replaced by StaticList.stagedMembershipDelta, a fourth published question alongside pendingCommands / cachedRecords / hasStagedCommands. It also drops ids with no datapoint instead of mapping them to undefined, which the inline version put straight into the reported delta. Covered by static_list_membership_delta.test.js (5 tests).
  - colibri.js called core._trackProm. interaction_service is a peer of colibri, not its owner, and this is the only cross-module call in public/; the underscore was the error, not the call. Renamed to trackProm.
